column4:
Progress on the Path tracks your quests, random events, world map locations, collectable items and Gwent cards as you play.
Hover over a setting to see what it does.
Runs a full update of everything Progress on the Path tracks whenever you start meditating, then shows a summary of anything new.
Lets you run a full update at any time with the Full Update key, which you can change under Controls. It can be used once every 5 seconds.
Adds (Collected) or (Needed) after the names of tracked gear, trophies and Gwent cards in shops and the crafting menu, so you can see at a glance whether you still need one.
Shows a map pin for every random event you have unlocked but not yet completed.
When on, each event pin describes its event. When off, every pin uses the same general description.
Size of the area circle drawn around each event pin on the map.
The icon used for event map pins.
Starting New Game+? Turn this on and close the menu to clear everything this save has recorded. Switches itself back off once applied.
Quest Progress: main quests, side quests, contracts, scavenger hunts, treasure hunts and random events.
World Map Progress: bandit camps, monster nests, places of power, signposts and every other map location.
Collectable Items Progress: rare and unique armor, weapons and trophies.
Gwent Card Progress: every Gwent card, by faction. Needs access to your Gwent deck.
Missable Quest Progress: quests you can lock yourself out of, grouped by what closes them off, with a warning for any active point of no return.

Choose which notifications Progress on the Path shows and how they look.
Main Update notifications summarise a full update. Realtime Updates appear as soon as you complete something.

<font color="#9BAADD">Enabled:</font> every notification. <font color="#9BAADD">Lite Mode:</font> full update summaries and new event messages, without realtime updates. <font color="#9BAADD">Disabled:</font> no notifications at all.
Shows a message when Progress on the Path has been updated to a new version.
Colour of notification text. Each option shows two shades: the first is used on the standard notification panel, the second on the optional Progress on the Path panel.
How many seconds each notification stays on screen.
Lists completed quests in the full update summary.
Lists completed world map locations in the full update summary.
Lists newly collected items in the full update summary.
Lists newly collected Gwent cards in the full update summary.
Lists completed random events in the full update summary.
Still shows the full update summary when nothing new was found.
Shows a notification as soon as you complete a quest.
Shows a notification as soon as you complete a world map location.
Shows a notification as soon as you collect a tracked item.
Shows a notification as soon as you collect a Gwent card.
Shows a notification as soon as you complete a random event.
Shows a notification when a new random event becomes available, with its name and location.
Shows a notification when you change an entry with the ptc console command.
